brief:
Washington Post journalist Heidi Levine was knocked down, kicked and struck with sticks by Israeli settlers in an attack last week, Middle East Eye reported. Levine recounted the incident as she documented the climate of fear Palestinians face in the occupied territories.

The assault on the foreign correspondent occurred while she was reporting on settler violence and Palestinian communities' experience of threats and intimidation in the West Bank.
dek: Journalist Heidi Levine recounts Israeli settler attack and Palestinians’ daily fear Washington Post journalist Heidi Levine has described how Israeli settlers knocked her down, kicked her and struck her with sticks during an attack last week.
title: Israeli settlers attack Washington Post journalist Heidi Levine
